Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Vacancies are distributed project-wise (Pariyojna-wise) across 5 Child Development Project areas of Gautam Buddha Nagar district, with category-wise reservation for each post. Combined Grand Total: 267 posts (84 Anganwadi Karyakatri + 183 Anganwadi Sahayika). The full Gram Sabha/Ward-wise vacancy list and reservation eligibility details are uploaded on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in and are also available at the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil, Vikas Khand, and Child Development Project offices in the district. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease.

content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women (female) candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. Educational Qualification: Minimum qualification for both Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts is Intermediate (12th pass) or its equivalent, up to a maximum of Postgraduate. Merit will be determined based on qualification level from Intermediate to Postgraduate. Residency: The applicant must be a resident of the Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or of the same Ward (for urban areas) where the vacant post is located. If an eligible candidate is not available within the Gram Sabha, selection will be made from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat as per seniority. Widows: A death certificate and a certified copy of the family register (Parivar Panjika) issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay will be considered valid proof. Divorced/Abandoned (Parityakta) women: Only a legal order issued by the Hon'ble Court will be considered valid. Income Certificate: Only an income certificate issued by the competent authority as per UP Government Revenue Section-9 order No. 3959/1-9-11-A0-9 dated 30.09.2011 (as amended), which is verifiable online, will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is not specified in this notification.

content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for vacant Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts will be conducted entirely online through the portal, as per the guidelines set out in the Government Order. No written examination or interview will be conducted. Selection will first be made from among eligible candidates below the poverty line (BPL), as per seniority within the age limit. If eligible BPL candidates are not available, selection will proceed to candidates above the poverty line, as per seniority. Merit will be determined based on educational qualification, ranging from Intermediate to Postgraduate. Residency in the relevant Gram Sabha/Ward is a mandatory eligibility condition; in its absence within the Gram Sabha, candidates from the concerned Nyaya Panchayat will be considered as per seniority. Two women belonging to the same family will not be appointed to Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts at the same centre. If an error is found in the application, or if any data/marks/educational documents submitted are found to be incorrect or fabricated, the candidature will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27
content_sections.text: Visit the departmental website, http://upanganwadibharti.in. Register and fill the online application form with all required personal, educational, residency, and category details. Upload self-attested, clear and legible scanned copies of all documents mentioned in the online form. Ensure the Residence Certificate is issued with the digital signature of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate, and the Income and Caste Certificates are issued with the digital signature of the Tehsildar - these documents must be verifiable through the e-District portal. Applications sent offline or by post will not be accepted under any circumstances - online submission through the portal is the only valid mode. Submit the completed application before the last date, 28.09.2026, midnight (12:00 AM).

content_sections.heading: Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised Anganwadi Karyakatri and Sahayika posts. No application sent offline or by post will be considered valid - only the online application submitted through the portal will be accepted. All uploaded documents must be self-attested, clean, and legible copies as referenced in the online application form. If any error, incorrect data, or fabricated document/marks is found in the application, the candidature will be summarily rejected. The number of vacant posts indicated is provisional and may increase or decrease. Two women from the same family will not be appointed to Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts at one centre. Detailed eligibility criteria and the full application procedure are available on the departmental website http://upanganwadibharti.in, and further information can be obtained from the concerned Child Development Project Officer's office, or from the District Programme Officer's office at Vikas Bhavan, Room No. 110, Ground Floor, Surajpur, Greater Noida, on any working day between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. What is Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notice issued by the District Programme Officer, Gautam Buddha Nagar, for filling 267 honorarium-based (contract) posts of Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) under the Child Development Projects in the district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 267 total vacancies - 84 Anganwadi Karyakatri (Worker) and 183 Anganwadi Sahayika (Helper) - distributed across 5 project areas: Shahar, Bisrakh, Dankaur, Dadri, and Jewar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 28.09.2026, midnight (12:00 AM).

faq.question: Q4. Who is eligible to apply for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: Only women candidates aged 18–35 years (as on 01.07.2026), with a minimum qualification of Intermediate (up to a maximum of Postgraduate), who are residents of the relevant Gram Sabha or Ward, are eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 01.07.2026. Only the High School marksheet/certificate is valid proof of age.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Anganwadi Karyakatri/Sahayika posts?
faq.answer: Selection is conducted entirely online through the portal, based on merit (educational qualification) and BPL priority as per seniority. No written examination or interview is conducted.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Gautam Buddha Nagar Anganwadi Bharti 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply only through http://upanganwadibharti.in, uploading all required self-attested documents, before the closing date of 28.09.2026.

faq.question: Q8. Can offline or postal applications be submitted for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No. Applications sent offline or by post will not be considered valid - only online applications submitted through the portal will be accepted.
